Molecular design · photophysics

White-light emitters

A closed-loop search for single-material white emission, built on excited-state proton transfer and dual-band emission.

Each candidate is optimized in the ground state, then checked with TD-DFT for its absorption, relaxed S1 emission, and singlet-triplet gap in ORCA. The map below places 94 candidates by their HOMO-LUMO gap and ground-state dipole. 31 of them carry a full excited-state calculation. computational

design spaceclick a point
HBTESIPT

The lead two-component blend reached neutral white at CIE (0.325, 0.319), 5900 K, 0.016 from the D65 point. Twisted intramolecular charge transfer was identified as the obstruction to single-molecule white emission.

Materials & molecular engineering

MOF organic linkers

A substituent and ring-system sweep across dicarboxylate linkers, each with its own quantum-chemical fingerprint.

245 linkers across 9 ring families were optimized and characterized by DFT for energy, dipole, and polarizability. The map reads polarizability against dipole, colored by ring family, so the chemical design space is visible at a glance. computational

Protein & de novo design

Designed metalloenzymes

One reaction, aromatic ring hydroxylation at a non-heme Fe(II) center, taken from a catalytic motif to scored scaffolds.

Backbones are generated with RFdiffusion3, sequenced with LigandMPNN, refolded with Boltz across seeds, then gated on whether the design actually rebuilds a catalytic 2-His-1-carboxylate site with the substrate in near-attack range. Of 29 designs, 1 cleared every geometry gate. computational

Design landscape

Every scored design, by geometry score against how close the substrate sits to the metal. The cleared design stands apart; most never build the site.

score vs substrate distancehover
the funnel
  1. Build the site. retrieve a real motif, place the substrate
  2. Generate backbones. RFdiffusion3, about 6 s per design on one RTX 5090
  3. Design sequence. LigandMPNN with the ligand in context
  4. Refold. Boltz across seeds; must rebuild its own site
  5. Gate on geometry. donor distances, triad angles, near-attack
  6. Quantum chemistry. ORCA cluster optimization of the active site

Materials centerpiece

Protein nanocage platform

A platform for self-assembling protein nanocages, built for scale and for honest provenance over hundreds of thousands of files.

reference architecture

A reference capsid architecture from the scaffold library, shown for scale and symmetry. The designed shells and their coarse-grained whole-cage trajectories live in the private platform.

Metal-site quantum chemistry

Coordination priors from first principles

A library of metal coordination geometries computed per metal, donor set, and spin state, so the design gates carry a quantum-chemical prior rather than a guess. Built as an HPC job array and parsed into a queryable table. computational

Scientific software & infrastructure

Instruments, not just repositories

The engineering behind the science, packaged and tested. Each tool is its own repository. The two marked ready are packaged, tested, and staged for release; the design engines stay private while the methods are unpublished.

polymer-engine

ready

Orchestration engine for computational polymer discovery over MD and QM, with provenance, active learning, and a multi-backend parameterization layer. 1016 tests.

github.com/Hun731/polymer-engine

orca-tools

ready

ORCA output parsing, Seminario force-constant derivation, and job-status triage. Reaction agnostic, no research data. 25 tests.

github.com/Hun731/orca-tools

foundry-studio

planned

Browser workbench for de novo design over RFdiffusion3, LigandMPNN, and Boltz, with an active-site builder, docking, and pocket detection.

packaging

mof-ai

planned

Property prediction with DFT validation in the loop for MOF linkers. Nine model families with cross-validation and SHAP.

packaging

metal-site-qm

planned

Enumerator and parser for metal coordination QM libraries on a cluster. Config example, no job data.

packaging

biodesign-env

planned

Parameterized installer for the ORCA, OpenMPI, and CUDA toolchain behind the pipelines.
